subject: english
question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Curious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Interested.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Curious"** means eager to know or learn something. (जिज्ञासु)

 
 
• **Example: **Children are naturally curious about the world around them.
 
 
 
• **"Interested" **refers to showing curiosity or concern about something or someone; being engaged or attentive. (रुचि रखने वाला)
 
 
• **Example: **She was very interested in learning new languages.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Interested**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Callous **(कठोर): Showing or having an insensitive and cruel disregard for others.

 
 
• **Example:** His callous comments about the accident upset everyone.
 
 
 
• **Benign **(सौम्य): Gentle and kind; not harmful.
 
 
• **Example: **His benign smile made everyone feel comfortable.
 
 
 
• **Agile** (फुर्तीला): Able to move quickly and easily.
 
 
• **Example:** The agile dancer moved effortlessly across the stage.
